case_01_n26_savings_rate.description: N26 Instant Savings interest rate increase across tiers (Metal up to 3.00%)
case_01_n26_savings_rate.ground_truth_summary: N26 introduced tiered Instant Savings interest: 1.26% on Standard, 2.26% on Smart/You, and 3.00% p.a. on Metal accounts.
case_01_n26_savings_rate.ground_truth_why_it_matters: Directly challenges Trade Republic's uninvested cash interest (3.75%), narrowing the gap for premium banking users.

case_02_n26_plan_fee_revision.description: N26 You plan price increase from 9.90 EUR to 10.90 EUR / month
case_02_n26_plan_fee_revision.ground_truth_summary: N26 You plan monthly subscription increased from 9.90 € to 10.90 € / month.
case_02_n26_plan_fee_revision.ground_truth_why_it_matters: Increases subscription revenue baseline for N26 while highlighting Trade Republic's no-monthly-fee card proposition.

case_03_revolut_ultra_launch.description: Revolut introduced the new Ultra tier at 45.00 EUR / month with Platinum card
case_03_revolut_ultra_launch.ground_truth_summary: Revolut launched its top-tier Ultra subscription plan at 45.00 € / month with platinum card and lounge access.
case_03_revolut_ultra_launch.ground_truth_why_it_matters: Targets ultra-high-net-worth retail banking users, testing willingness to pay top-tier SaaS fees in fintech.

case_04_revolut_weekend_fx_fee.description: Revolut increased weekend currency exchange fee from 0.5% to 1.0% on major FX pairs
case_04_revolut_weekend_fx_fee.ground_truth_summary: Revolut updated weekend currency exchange markup from 0.5% to 1.0% for major currencies.
case_04_revolut_weekend_fx_fee.ground_truth_why_it_matters: Increases hidden cost for cross-border spending, creating a competitive talking point for Trade Republic zero-FX fee card.

case_05_revolut_crypto_fee.description: Revolut reduced crypto trading fee from 1.49% to 0.99% for Standard users
case_05_revolut_crypto_fee.ground_truth_summary: Revolut reduced crypto exchange commission from 1.49% to 0.99% (or minimum 0.99 €).
case_05_revolut_crypto_fee.ground_truth_why_it_matters: Narrowed crypto trading pricing against Trade Republic's 1.00 € flat fee, especially for small order sizes.

case_06_scalable_interest_rate.description: Scalable Capital reduced Prime+ interest rate on uninvested cash from 4.00% to 3.75% p.a.
case_06_scalable_interest_rate.ground_truth_summary: Scalable Capital adjusted Prime+ cash interest from 4.00% to 3.75% p.a. on deposits up to 1,000,000 EUR.
case_06_scalable_interest_rate.ground_truth_why_it_matters: Scalable's rate parity with Trade Republic (3.75%), but Scalable requires a 4.99 €/mo subscription vs Trade Republic free rate.

case_07_scalable_order_threshold.description: Scalable Capital Free Broker PRIME ETF free order threshold raised from 250 EUR to 500 EUR
case_07_scalable_order_threshold.ground_truth_summary: Scalable Capital Free Broker changed PRIME ETF fee threshold: orders below 500 € now cost 0.99 € (previously 250 €).
case_07_scalable_order_threshold.ground_truth_why_it_matters: Forces smaller retail trades to pay 0.99 € order fee, reducing Free Broker appeal compared to free Trade Republic savings plans.

case_08_bitpanda_staking_apy.description: Bitpanda adjusted Ethereum staking APY from 3.8% to 3.1% and Solana from 6.5% to 5.8%
case_08_bitpanda_staking_apy.ground_truth_summary: Bitpanda reduced staking yield on ETH from 3.8% to 3.1% and SOL from 6.5% to 5.8%.
case_08_bitpanda_staking_apy.ground_truth_why_it_matters: Reflects network-wide yield compression; preserves crypto staking yield comparison benchmarks for PMs.

case_09_bitpanda_deposit_fee.description: Bitpanda eliminated credit card and instant deposit fees from 1.50% to 0.00%
case_09_bitpanda_deposit_fee.ground_truth_summary: Bitpanda removed deposit fees across credit cards, PayPal, and Sofort (previously 1.50% fee).
case_09_bitpanda_deposit_fee.ground_truth_why_it_matters: Removes fiat on-ramp friction, accelerating conversion funnel against Trade Republic's free card and instant top-ups.

case_10_micro_numeric_fee_shift.description: Foreign currency markup shift from 1.70% to 1.65% embedded in noisy timestamped markup
case_10_micro_numeric_fee_shift.ground_truth_summary: Foreign ATM currency conversion markup on Standard tier adjusted from 1.70% to 1.65%.
case_10_micro_numeric_fee_shift.ground_truth_why_it_matters: 5 bps reduction in FX fee margin, demonstrating micro-numeric fee diff sensitivity.
